visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Toggle hidden with a boolean
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The loop uses an if and else to hide or show each item. Assign the condition to the hidden property in one line. The filter must work the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
• Rose
  • Sky

solution.code:

  • Sky
solution.explanation: A comparison gives true or false, which is what the hidden property wants. The five lines of if and else become one line with the same meaning.
